ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the visible surface is approximately 98% dark-grey/black with minimal high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Overall uniform dark pigmentation (Type 5 classification) with minimal white patterning restricted to the extreme margins.
